reviews.title: Great way to track your strength training
reviews.text: Wow- this is the one! The price is reasonable and it makes it easy to record my sets/reps/weight, or even random things like resistance band color can be recorded through notes. It shows what muscles I worked last, what hasn’t been worked, and allows me to easily input my more non-traditional exercises. I don’t think I will need any other tracker- this one is comprehensive and simple to use.

reviews.title: Excellent app, amazing customer support
reviews.text:
Somehow, I ended up with two separate accounts—one of which hasn’t been used since September 2022. CS managed to merge my two accounts, so now I have data going back more than 4 years. 

To the app itself, it’s an amazing tool to have in your weight training arsenal. You control everything: sets, plates weights, bar weights, plate machine starting weights, intervals between sets… this thing does everything for you but rinse off the dishes of your *obviously* protein-dense post-workout meal. :) 

Get it. Use it. Love it.

reviews.title: Great app!
reviews.text:
Setgraph is easy to use and the UI is nice to look at. I love seeing the total volume of weight I’ve lifted during each session, as well as the ability to see my past workouts so I can progressively overload each exercise. 

Overall the app is spectacular, especially if you like data. I’m bad at keeping up with specific exercises and volumes of sets, so this has been a game changer.

reviews.title: Waiting for tech support response
reviews.text:
I just purchased the app two days ago and I was loving it and still could
Continue. My problem is that I have created an entire routine and defined all the equipment I want to use (machines only) and I did my first set and everything was great - I had to uninstall the app because I initially create the account us g login with google and I wanted to just login with my email so I backed up the data from the app and for my surprise after I created my new account and was ready to load my backup, I got the surprise info that the app doesn’t have a freaking way to load your backup, it is simply a freaking CSV file that you can use to manually redo the entire thing step by step which is absurd. 

I emailed customer support and sent them my backup files because online they supposed to be able to load my backup for me so I can continue to use the app.. I sofre from severe ADHD + complex PTSD and too me forever to setup this stuff and now I’m so frustrated that if this doesn’t get resolved  by the 5th I’ll cancel my request to upgrade to the pro package…

Please help me and I’ll update my review to 5 stars.

Also add some clear information about your “export” feature so people like me knows that this is just for you to save your data for some reason other than believe that you can save your work and later reload on the al and keep going. You need to give people the real and full story - when you ready your explanation is sounds like you are able to export and backup your data for easy retrieval later which is not the case - I can only imagine how people who workout everyday and have the app filled with data would feel if they did what I have done.

Thanks

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text:
I am a big fan of this app. It isn’t overly complicated and lays out a solid format for progressive overload session to session. This frees up my time in and out of the gym and enables my programs to work efficiently. 

I would like to see something akin to a RIR or RPE selection on each performed exercise. It would also be helpful to see notes from last session pop up - for example, if I open one of the folders and begin a session, the notes I typed in on the exercises would pop up and inform this training session. “This set felt a little off, slowed down the eccentric portion to feel more MMC and it helped “ knowing little form tweaks or things to focus on when walking into a session could be helpful.
